paragraphs: Safience sells identity intelligence software that looks only for predefined threats, persons of interest and missing persons, matched against a database built from law enforcement records. The site belongs to Biometrica Systems, Inc., a software and data company that supports federal, state, tribal and local law enforcement and private sector safety teams. Its RTIS and RVIS edge sensors capture a single still image rather than video or audio, and any image that does not match a predefined profile is purged immediately. The company states that an alert follows within 60 seconds of a detection and that database queries return in under 5 seconds.

The database behind the system holds 57.3M+ unique individuals and receives over 50,000 new records per day. Those records come from published law enforcement records, agency JMS/RMS integrations, an OffenderWatch partnership and missing-person records, with no OSINT, social media or consumer data. It also markets the system to airports and mass transit, banks, schools and universities, hospitals, hotels, retailers and stadiums.

A second product, eMotive, turns a one-time criminal background check into a continuous, FCRA-compliant alert system for employers, with written consent required from each monitored individual. Matching for eMotive is performed by a third-party, NIST-approved provider in an isolated environment, and Biometrica staff do not see employee match notifications. Biometrica holds the U.S. patent for System and Method for Continuous Biometric Monitoring.

quote.text: We identify threats or victims in under 60 seconds. Privacy-first. Real-time. Nationwide.
